notes.ratio16Floor: ratio 16 at SS10 gives 44.8mm, just below SS10's own supportedHeightRangeMm minimum of 45 -- expected, since the whole floor region under test sits below the validated range.
notes.trackingTarget: trackingTarget "separation" is an intent, not a letterSpacingMm. The render milestone resolves the actual letterSpacingMm reaching a separation ratio >= 0.95 and records the achieved values in its own key file.
notes.rhinestoneProbe: rs-block / rs-modern are a separate "unmeasured" stratum (authored stone positions, no outline stem to measure); they cannot be pooled with the stem-regime strata. Included because rs-block is the default Production Font.
